audit.why: Levels 1-3 are Rumble on the 38.89% / 126-game data and the level chart; Skill at 4-5; Master Yi from 6 onward. Master Yi tops out sooner than a normal melee because Highlander (R, 85s) removes the only thing Rumble uses to hold spacing.
audit.corrected: Early lane Rumble, flip at Master Yi level 6, side lane and 1v1s Master Yi for the rest of the game.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and first-item spikes described Master Yi as "sprinting past your zone" and "closing through your slows" without naming why either works.
audit.why: Highlander explicitly makes him immune to all slowing effects, and Wuju Style adds true damage, so the two spikes are slow-immunity and resistance-bypass, not raw speed.
audit.corrected: Level 6 spike = Highlander slow immunity (85s cooldown). First-item spike = Wuju Style true damage making MR purchases irrelevant.

audit.whatIsWrong: No ability-by-ability interaction was stated. Electro Harpoon (E) and The Equalizer (R) are Rumble’s entire answer, and both are slows; Highlander cancels slows outright. Meditate (W) is a channel Rumble has no CC to break. Wuju Style (E) true damage voids MR.
audit.why: Riot text: Highlander "making him immune to all slowing effects"; Wuju Style "Grants bonus true damage"; Meditate is a channel that restores Health. Rumble’s kit contains no hard CC at all — Flamespitter (Q) is a damage cone, Scrap Shield (W) is a shield plus move speed, Electro Harpoon (E) is a slow and MR shred, The Equalizer (R) is damage plus slow.
audit.corrected: Hold Equalizer and harpoons for the window Highlander is down (85s). Expect Meditate to heal through chip damage uninterrupted — Grievous Wounds is the counter, not a cancel. Do not answer Wuju Style with MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in this matchup.
audit.why: Highlander is a flat 85s at every rank (reduced by kills/assists), which is the only reliable window Rumble has.
audit.corrected: Sequencing keyed to the 85s Highlander cooldown added to late.

audit.why: Meditate sustains and Wuju Style is true damage — the standard "buy MR" instinct is wrong here and Grievous Wounds is the real item lever.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds line added to mid; MR-is-not-the-answer stated in the first-item spike and whys[5].

edits.before: Late game he shreds a CC-light Rumble whenever he reaches you, so make reaching you the hard part: fight from behind your frontline, cut his path with Equalizer, and save the E slows for the instant he commits. You win teamfights with area denial; he wins duels — never offer him one.
edits.after: Late he shreds a CC-light Rumble on contact, so make contact the hard part: fight from behind your frontline and hold Equalizer and the E slows for the window his 85-second Highlander is down — he is slow-immune while it runs. You win the teamfight zone; he wins every duel.

notes: Derived-flag misfire: rumble.json tags Scrap Shield (W) with knockup and terrain, and The Equalizer (R) with terrain. Riot’s own descriptions say Scrap Shield is a shield plus a move-speed burst (no displacement, no wall) and The Equalizer is a damaging, slowing wall of flames (not physical terrain). _missing-interactions.json therefore generates a false "your W and R shut off Alpha Strike" headline for both directions of this matchup — I did NOT write that claim, and the masteryi-side "dash-denied" entry for rumble is wrong for the same reason. Also: CHAMP_FULL.rumble has no masteryi key (71 enemies, Master Yi absent), so no full-layer edits were possible — content layer only.
